title: Orchestrable pedagogical situation (design-only)

components.design_note: Versioned learning activity dependency graph; preserve the original activity owner.
Learning objectives, exercise repository, criteria and cultural sources remain external.
Optional fictional/narrative setting and its provenance; keep fiction distinct from documented facts.
Pedagogical roles, team interactions and resource links, not actual identity or access rights.
Derived solo/8/30 learner what-if plans; never promote simulation to operational execution.
External teacher-reviewed session evidence/audit; never fold learner records into the public blueprint.

guidance: Design-only assembly. All external references must be resolved and pinned by their owners prior to qualified use. The situation is not a live session, school admission, evaluation, or access grant.
